description: Verify integer-index grid construction when the last event is not aligned with the requested sampling frequency.

oracle.description: The canonical grid is [0.1, 0.35, 0.6, 0.85]. The next point, 1.1, exceeds the last event time, and the irregular endpoint 1.0 is not appended. Uniform 0.3 second event intervals yield the constant analytical rate 10/3 Hz at all four grid points. This short ihr-only request does not invoke the TVIPFM filter.
